snippet.title: Aarik And The Ruined Kingdom Nintendo Switch Trailer
snippet.description:
Aarik's adventure is heading to the Nintendo Switch™. Play any way you like and make your way through a plethora of perspective puzzles!

Launching 26th of March 2026

Available for pre-order here: https://www.nintendo.com/store/products/aarik-and-the-ruined-kingdom-switch/
